cases.question: 用 CTE 统计每月订单数，并给出每月订单占全年比例（2017 年）。
cases.golden_sql: WITH monthly AS (SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', order_purchase_timestamp) AS month, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-01-01' GROUP BY month) SELECT month, cnt, ROUND(cnt * 100.0 / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM monthly), 2) AS pct FROM monthly ORDER BY month
cases.pred_sql:
WITH monthly_orders AS (
  SELECT 
    strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS order_month,
    COUNT(*) AS monthly_count
  FROM orders o
  WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01' 
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-01-01'
  GROUP BY order_month
),
annual_total AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_orders
  FROM orders o
  WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01' 
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-01-01'
)
SELECT 
  mo.order_month,
  mo.monthly_count,
  ROUND((mo.monthly_count * 100.0 / at.total_orders), 2) || '%' AS percentage_of_year
FROM monthly_orders mo
CROSS JOIN annual_total at
ORDER BY mo.order_month
